programme.title: Я люблю готовить. Необычные салаты
programme.desc: Салаты очень полезные, если их готовить из свежих овощей и фруктов. Давайте приготовим два салата с необычным сочетанием продуктов. Ингредиенты Салат из свеклы с апельсином и сыром: Свекла – 200 г Апельсин – 1 шт. Салат латук – 3-4 листа Творожный сыр – 100 г Пармезан тертый – 1 ст. л. Масло оливковое – 1 ч. л. Бальзамический уксус – 1 ч. л. Салат с запеченной тыквой, фетой и шпинатом: Очищенная тыква – 500 г Оливковое масло – 1 ст. л. Чеснок – 1 зубчик Грецкие орехи – 20 г Семена тыквы – 1 ст. л. Шпинат – 50 г Сыр фета – 80 г Киноа – 30 г Вода для киноа – 60 мл Заправка: Оливковое масло – 2 ст. л. Бальзамический уксус – 1 ст.л. Мед – 1 ст. л. Соль, перец – по вкусу Ведущий: Елена Солдатова

Много кто хочет попасть в Царство Божье, но мало кто знает, что жить в нём можно уже сейчас, на этой земле. Каким образом это возможно? Какую роль в этом играет Божий закон? programme.desc: 10 мая 1570 г. в Москве состоялся диспут между Иваном Грозным и чешским богословом Яном Рокитой. Чешский проповедник, сторонник Мартина Лютера, пользуясь случаем представил идеи Реформации перед царём и боярами. В чём взгляды этих людей сошлись, а в чём – нет? programme.desc: В Ветхом Завете люди приходили к священнику и он совершал обряд, который очищал человека от греха. Бог дал пророку Моисею подробные указания – что, как и когда нужно приносить в жертву. Одна из жертв называлась жертвой всесожжения. Что это такое? Чем она отличалась от других жертв? Как она указывала на Иисуса Христа? Ведущий: Алексей Бритов, Гость: Виталий Олийник, руководитель Центра духовного просвещения

programme.title: Контрасты души. Правда или ложь: что выбрать?
programme.desc: Сказать правду или солгать – эта проблема встает часто. Ложь по мелочам и ложь в серьезной ситуации, когда кажется, что она спасет человека. Можно ли лгать во благо? Непростой вопрос еще более осложняется тем, что ни один современный человек практически никогда не говорит одну только правду. Когда и как следует выбирать правду и когда ложь? В этой практической проблеме помогает разобраться психолог-консультант Василий Половинко. Ведущий: Игорь Кириченко, Гость: Василий Половинко, психолог-консультант, священнослужитель

programme.title: Возрождая Россию. Служение семьям
programme.desc: В современном мире постоянно происходит множество изменений: в технологическом укладе, в отношениях в семье, в организации труда и отдыха. Нужно ли противиться или поддерживать эти изменения? Гости программы семейные консультанты Мария и Владимир Вачевы рассказывают о своем служении семьям, о проблемах современных семей, делятся своим мнением о будущем института семьи. Ведущий: Валерий Малышев, Гость: Мария Вачева, психолог, семейный консультант и Владимир Вачев, священнослужитель, семейный консультант

programme.title: Тайна жизни. Колибри
programme.desc: Самая маленькая птица на земном шаре – колибри. Это одно из самых красивых Божьих творений. Колибри живут там, где есть цветы, но особенно много их в тропиках. Большинство людей знает, что колибри является самой маленькой птичкой на земле и, пожалуй, на этом у многих познания об этом изумительном творении заканчиваются. В нашей программе вы узнаете не только об маневренности этой птицы и особенностях её строения, но и поразмышляете вместе с нами об возможностях синхронной эволюции колибри и цветка, которым она питается. Ведущий: Ольга Феофанова, Гость: Дарья Хасанова, магистр биологии

programme.title: Чашка семейного счастья. Как деньги могут разрушить или укрепить брак?
programme.desc: Долги, скрытые траты и разные подходы к бюджету – главные враги молодой семьи. Как вести честные финансовые переговоры и распределять роли? Почему верность в малом определяет ваше будущее благополучие? Как щедрость становится духовной практикой? Ведущий: Ирина Флорьянович, психолог, Гость: Сергей Парфенов, священнослужитель

programme.title: Принято считать. Третий лишний в отношениях
programme.desc: Треугольники в отношениях разрушают прямой диалог, отнимают силы и наполняют союзы ревностью, обидами и скрытой конкуренцией. «Третьим» может оказаться не только роман на стороне, но и мама, ребёнок, работа, зависимость или даже благочестивое служение. Классический треугольник спаситель–жертва–преследователь позволяет избегать изменений, но при этом медленно разрушает всех участников. Как понять, что вы уже живёте в треугольнике, а не в союзе «я–ты»? Какие шаги помогут вернуться к честной, прямой встрече друг с другом? Ведущий: Юлия Синицына, Гость: Ирина Полищук, психолог, телесно-ориентированный терапевт

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T19 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Quando, em casa, perguntam à Tia Cátia o que é o jantar, responde: é arroz com atum! E muitas vezes é mesmo! Porém, este clássico é sempre reinventado. Dito isto, temos: Arancini, feito com arroz e atum, claro está, e devidamente recheado com queijo mozarela, que derrete depois de fritar! Pataniscas estaladiças de atum, acompanhadas por um belíssimo arroz de tomate e pimentos.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T6 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: No programa de hoje aterramos na Suíça e seremos presentados por 3 pratos típicos do país feitos pelo Henrique. Para entrada teremos um pizokel, para prato principal um Rösti com Vitela e, por fim, uma tarte, uma Nusstorte de lamber os dedos.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T6 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje paramos por mais um país da Europa, a Suécia. Para entrada, o Henrique, começará por fazer uma Pyttipanna, uma receita feita com sobras de comida, de seguida, para prato principal, como não podia deixar de ser, umas Almôndegas e, para sobremesa um deliciosos Rolos de Canela.

programme.title: Comtradição Pelo Mundo T6 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Localizada no Leste Europeu, a Hungria é o país onde o Henrique aterrará hoje e nos mostrará receitas deliciosas. Como entrada teremos um Hortobágyi, uma receita com base de crepe. Para prato principal um Goulash com um toque português e, por fim, um bolo desconstruído com sultanas mergulhadas em vinho do porto, um Somlói Galuska.

programme.title: Jamie: Cozinha E Segue T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Jamie faz uma sobremesa deliciosa de Páscoa, com uma extravagância de pão quente de chocolate. Além disso, e se está à procura de pratos fáceis para o fim de semana, Jamie também partilha o seu cordeiro assado com legumes de primavera e uns bolinhos de peixe asiáticos super rápidos.

programme.title: Jamie: Cozinha E Segue T1 - Ep. 16
programme.desc: Jamie aproveita ao máximo os restos do cordeiro de Páscoa num fantástico biryani assado no tabuleiro e mostra-nos receitas para uma lasanha de beringelas e noodles reconfortantes para a ressaca.

programme.title: Jamie: Cozinha E Segue T1 - Ep. 17
programme.desc: Jamie mostra-nos mais receitas incríveis adaptadas para o período peculiar do confinamento, incluindo uma pizza folhada com cobertura estilo ratatouille, pães achatados de kofta de cordeiro e risoto de tomate.

programme.title: Nigella: Cozinhar com Paixão T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Criar pratos que causem sensação não tem de ser stressante. Nigella partilha alguns dos seus favoritos de fazer crescer água na boca, mas que são surpreendentemente simples. Apresenta-nos o bolo preferido da sua infância, explora as ruas de Londres em busca de ingredientes vegan e mostra-nos os ingredientes surpreendentes de uma sobremesa profundamente sofisticada.

programme.title: Nigella: Cozinhar com Paixão T1 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Nigella partilha connosco o seu amor de sempre por aquilo que chama o bacon do mar - a humilde anchova, com o seu sabor poderoso. Ficamos ainda a conhecer uma receita estranha, mas histórica, preparada com anchovas, um molho para todo o ano, um molho de salada cremoso e um prato de massa colorido e sofisticado.

programme.title: Nigella: Cozinhar com Paixão T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Para aquelas noites longas de Inverno, Nigella tem algumas receitas caseiras tradicionais na manga. Para além de partilhar uma receita que herdou da avó, ela mostra-nos algumas refeições inspiradas pelo seu bairro de Londres. Como sempre, Nigella coloca a sua assinatura inconfundível nestes pratos e torna-os ainda mais especiais.

programme.title: Nigella: Cozinhar com Paixão T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Toda a gente adora a comida de conforto, mas neste episódio ela surge com melhor aspeto e sabor do que nunca. Desde uma receita herdada da mãe a um toque refinado num clássico incontornável, descubra a melhor comida de conforto com um pouco de sofisticação. Até porque, afinal, estamos na cozinha de Nigella!.

programme.title: Doces Do Ofício T2 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: A uma boa bolacha nunca se diz que não e as melhores são mesmo as feitas em casa. O Francisco prepara três receitas de bolachas e mostra alguns truques para ficarem irrecusáveis. Por exemplo, as american cookies, com aquela textura mais elástica e húmida, precisam de um choque térmico. As bolachas estaladiças de manteiga de amendoim ficam perfeitas se o amendoim for torrado.

programme.title: Doces Do Ofício T2 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Não é preciso procurar muito para descobrir sobremesas incríveis, nos quatro cantos do mundo. O Francisco sugere três: Da Áustria, o Sachertorte: um bolo húmido, com camadas de compota de alperce e ganache de chocolate. Do Brasil, a simplicidade do tradicional Quindim... com todo o seu sabor a coco. E da Bélgica, a Speculoos: uma bolacha típica, crocante e rica em especiarias.

programme.title: Doces Do Ofício T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: O Francisco é fã de crepes, sobretudo porque são muito versáteis. Primeiro, fará o clássico crepe suzette, flambeado com uma calda e licor de laranja. Depois, vai transformar uma massa de crepes simples em trouxas com fangipane cremoso de noz e morango. Para último, deixa os burritos de cacau, feitos com massa de crepes, recheados com fruta salteada e creme leve de lima.

programme.title: As Doces Iguarias De Rudolph T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Mestre Rudolph van Veen mostra-nos o seu conhecimento e paixão para a cozinha. Ele cria os mais deliciosos pratos doces e salgados, deixando-nos ficar com água na boca. Rudolph sabe como criar as receitas mais encantadoras, e com a sua ajuda todos podem fazer bolos e os mais deliciosos pastéis e tortas.

programme.title: As Doces Iguarias De Rudolph T1 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Mestre Rudolph van Veen mostra-nos o seu conhecimento e paixão para a cozinha. Ele cria os mais deliciosos pratos doces e salgados, deixando-nos ficar com água na boca. Rudolph sabe como criar as receitas mais encantadoras, e com a sua ajuda todos podem fazer bolos e os mais deliciosos pastéis e tortas.

programme.title: Mary Berry: 90 Anos De Inspiração T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Gabby Logan tem um acidente com um ovo na cozinha com Mary Berry, enquanto preparavam o molho para um gravadlax curado com endro.

programme.title: Mary Berry: 90 Anos De Inspiração T1 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Mary Berry sente-se honrada por cozinhar ao lado do seu querido amigo, Jamie Oliver.

programme.title: Cozinhar À Italiana T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Silvia prepara dois pratos especiais de marisco para o 60º aniversário de um amigo próximo - zuppa di pesce e pargo assado.

programme.title: Cozinhar À Italiana T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Silvia partilha receitas italianas autênticas que são também vegetarianas, incluindo gnocchi alla sorrentina, minestrone com risoni e flores de curgete assadas com ricota e hortelã.

programme.title: Cozinhar À Italiana T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Silvia mostra-nos algumas das refeições mais clássicas de Itália para partilhar com amigos e família, incluindo lasanha escangalhada com ragu de borrego, fritto de curgete e camarão e ciambella de ricota.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 18
programme.desc: Quem não gosta de laranja? E quem pode negar que ela é capaz de nos proporcionar pratos deliciosos quando se transforma em doce para acompanhar uns rolinhos de espargos e bacon crocante, em molho para aromatizar uns filetes de peixe espada, ou quando se desfaz num leve e macio soufflé?.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 19
programme.desc: Ter preguiça de cozinhar não implica comer mal. É facílimo preparar umas bruschettas de espinafres e queijo brie, uns originais croquetes no forno com bacon, e uma maçã com gelado de gengibre e erva-doce, assada no micro-ondas.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 20
programme.desc: São várias as receitas que se tornaram verdadeiras estrelas de cinema. Que dizer do famoso batido de baunilha e banana do filme Pulp Fiction, do esparguete com almôndegas e molho de tomate que foi feito na cozinha do Padrinho, ou dos macarons que deliciavam Marie Antoinette?.

programme.title: Prato Do Dia T2 - Ep. 21
programme.desc: Haverá coisa melhor que despertar as memórias trazidas pelas receitas das nossas avós? Pratos como uma sopa de tomate com ovos escalfados, um arroz de pato à moda antiga, e uma aletria bem doce são motivos para uma dedicação especial na hora de cozinhar.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T8 - Ep. 38
programme.desc: A cozinha francesa marcou toda uma época... pelo menos na cozinha da mãe da Tia Cátia. Inspirada nesses tempos, propõe 3 receitas... merveilleuses! A tradicional quiche lorraine, com crème fraiche, ovos e bacon... Uma delícia super prática! Seguem-se os sabores mais complexos da terrina de pato com pimenta verde fresca, um toque de conhaque e de vinho do Porto.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T11 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Batch cooking é o termo utilizado para a maximização de recursos na cozinha. A partir de uma mesma preparação, a Tia Cátia vai gerar diferentes pratos. Curiosos? Começa-se por fazer a base: um bom molho de tomate, um molho branco, e legumes assados no forno. Com o molho de tomate e molho branco, a Tia Cátia vai preparar uma bolonhesa e ainda uma lasanha de atum, em menos de nada.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T8 - Ep. 36
programme.desc: Reciclar é dos verbos que a Tia Cátia mais conjuga na sua cozinha. Com uma pitada de criatividade, tudo se aproveita para criar novas refeições. As sobras de carnes variadas resultam em ótimos muffins, ideais para um snack. Com sobras de arroz e brócolos, fará um arroz de forno, bem ‘alimentado’ com atum e enriquecido com queijo. E quando sobra um pedaço de bolo simples, há que o transformar numa outra sobremesa.

programme.title: Comtradição T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Neste episódio o Henrique irá explorar os sabores da Guarda. Vamos começar por uma Sopa de Castanhas, de seguida um Coelho à Caçador e, para sobremesa, um Arroz Doce.

programme.title: Comtradição T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Hoje vamos descobrir as maravilhas gastronómicas do Distrito de Castelo Branco. Vamos cozinhar uns Fígados de Cebolada, uma bela Sopa da Beira e acabamos com a tradicional Tigelada.

programme.title: Comtradição T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Hoje vamos passear pelos sabores do Porto. O Henrique vai cozinhar umas Amêijoas à Bulhão Pato, um Bacalhau à Gomes de Sá (Pessoa) e, para terminar, não podiam faltar as Tripas à Moda do Porto.

programme.title: Comtradição T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: No programa de hoje vamos fazer um tour gastronómico pelo Distrito de Coimbra. Vamos cozinhar uma Chanfana, umas Moelas e terminamos de forma doce com um Pudim das Clarissas.

programme.title: À Mesa De Nisha Katona T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Nisha Katona cozinha um caril de rabo de boi e perna de vaca, além de camarões grelhados no churrasco com especiarias.

programme.title: À Mesa De Nisha Katona T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Nisha prepara mexilhões à malaia e bolinhos de caramelo com gordura de vaca, com a ajuda da filha.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T7 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje de “Dress to Impress” Miguel Mesquita apresenta- nos 3 receitas para impressionar os convidados: um “Soufflé de Queijo e Espinafres”, uma “Perna de Pato, Couve Roxa e Figos” e uma “Salada Doce de Suspiros e Citrinos”.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T7 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: No capítulo de hoje, Miguel Mesquita apresenta 3 receitas com um tipo de ingrediente com que adora cozinhar, as “Ervas Frescas”: Começa com um “Ceviche de Tofu”, com salsa, coentros e salicórnia, depois passa para uma “Vazia Grelhada com Molho Chimichurri”, onde o uso de orégãos e salsa é essencial e, por fim, uma “Tarte de Lima e Manjericão”, com estes sabores que a torna super especial.

programme.title: Chef De Serviço T7 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Chef De Serviço T7 - Ep. 9

programme.title: A Sentada T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Sandra Nobre cozinha Pargo em sumo de laranja com risotto de queijo parmesão, Costeletas de borrego em vinagre balsâmico e puré de feijão branco, e Creme brûle & bolachas shortbread escocesas.

programme.title: A Sentada T2 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Sandra Nobre cozinha Salada de mão de vaca com grão, Feijoada à moda da Sandra e Arroz de Bacalhau.

programme.title: A Sentada T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Sandra Nobre cozinha Mexilhões com creme de vinho branco, Salada Niçoise e Tarde de Alperce.

programme.title: Joana Express T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: O episódio de Joana Express de hoje é uma verdadeira ode à massa… ou quase. A abrir, um Gnocchi das Maravilhas que, apesar de ser feito de batata e não entrar oficialmente na família das pastas, comporta-se como tal e ninguém lhe leva a mal. Depois, uma massa pevide one pot, pensada para quem se quer despachar no fogão e usar um só caçoilo.

programme.title: Joana Express T1 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Como sempre em Joana Express, preza-se pela rapidez, e o episódio de hoje não é exceção. A primeira receita comprova que, com simplicidade, se fazem maravilhas, utilizando Cenouras, Feijão verde e Queijo da Ilha, que eleva aos céus esta entrada. No prato principal, o impossível torna-se possível em menos de 30 minutos: uma Feijoana Express, com a panela de pressão como grande aliada.

programme.title: Joana Express T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: No episódio de hoje de Joana Express o protagonista é o ovo, uma das proteínas mais queridas pelos personal trainers. Começamos com uns surpreendentes ovos vaporosos, de textura delicada, que lembra um pudim, mas numa versão bem mais proteica. Seguimos para uma omolete super cremosa, numa homenagem a Júlia Child e ao seu livro icónico Mastering the Art of French Cooking.

programme.title: À Descoberta Da Gastronomia Portuguesa Com Neven T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Neven Maguire dirige-se a Lisboa, onde faz uma paragem num dos marcos gastronómicos da capital, os Pastéis de Belém, uma pastelaria famosa pelos seus deliciosos pastéis de nata artesanais.

programme.title: À Descoberta Da Gastronomia Portuguesa Com Neven T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neven está na Madeira, onde visita a Blandy's Wine Lodge e prova uma variedade de vinhos, aprendendo a harmonizá-los com diferentes pratos. No The Views Baia Hotel, Neven aprende a fazer uma receita de pregado e erva-doce, e também faz uma visita ao mercado de peixe do Funchal. Neven também experimenta uma sanduíche tradicional portuguesa de carne de vaca e cozinha um strudel de cogumelos e alho-francês com molho de vinho da Madeira.

programme.title: À Descoberta Da Gastronomia Portuguesa Com Neven T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: A primeira paragem de Neven é no Centro da Banana da Madeira, uma plantação de bananas e centro de investigação com um museu de última geração na Ponta do Sol. De volta ao Funchal, Neven visita o Kampo, um restaurante português contemporâneo perto da catedral do século XVI da cidade e da movimentada zona portuária. Depois, faz um passeio gastronómico a pé para explorar e provar os produtos locais da cidade.

programme.title: À Descoberta Da Gastronomia Portuguesa Com Neven T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Neste episódio final, Neven regressa à cidade de Porto, no norte, prova vinhos de mesa na Graham's e, em Óbidos, experimenta um licor local, a ginjinha. De regresso à Madeira, dirige-se a uma quinta de cultivo de frutas tropicais e a um mercado de agricultores locais, onde explora espécies raras de frutas. Na costa nordeste, Neven prova vários tipos de rum. A sua receita da semana é uma tarte de maracujá e lima.

programme.title: Cadernos Da Filipa T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Neste episódio fazemos receitas maravilhosas para comer com as mãos! Começamos com umas Ostras com molho mignonette, depois um American Burguer e terminamos uns Queques de amendoim e chocolate que desaparecem num instante.

programme.title: Cadernos Da Filipa T2 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Neste episódio vamos dar vida àqueles restos esquecidos no frigorifico! Começamos com uns Cogumelos recheados com broa de coentrada depois fazemos uns Pudinzinhos de peixe e terminamos com um Bolo de anjo bem fofinho!.

programme.title: Cadernos Da Filipa T2 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Hoje vamos fazer receitas vegan que todos vão adorar! Fazemos umas Seitanas à portuguesa que são um sucesso depois um Caril de grão, brócolos e tofu e terminamos com uma maravilhosa Tarte vegan de chocolate e framboesa!.

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A cozinha dos anos 70 da produtora de eventos culinários Caryl Chinn é um desastre em termos de design, envergonhando-a durante as degustações com chefs de topo.

programme.title: Cozinhas Com Nova Vida T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Lisa adora cozinhar, mas a cozinha dela é um desastre. Ellen vai transformar esta cozinha no coração da casa.

programme.title: Renovações Em Família T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: Com a chegada de dois filhos gémeos e já com dois filhos mais velhos, Ellianna e John têm muito amor para dar, mas pouco espaço em casa. A equipa da Renovações em Família está pronta para transformar a casa num espaço onde toda a família possa desfrutar de momentos em conjunto.

programme.title: Renovações Em Família T1 - Ep. 2
programme.desc: Conheça a família Looper, composta por oito elementos, incluindo dois pares de gémeos nascidos com apenas dezassete meses de diferença. A equipa da Renovações em Família renova a casa para destacar a individualidade de cada adolescente e prepara ainda uma surpresa para os pais.

programme.title: Os Segredos Da Tia Cátia T19 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Hoje temos um chef entre nós. O talentoso e merecidamente premiado Pedro Pena Bastos vai à cozinha da Tia Cátia transformar ingredientes simples em pratos originais. Fará: Salada de grão aromatizada com especiarias. Leva ainda espinafres, avelã e requeijão de ovelha. Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Roads are much more than just gray strips of asphalt that allow us to travel and trade. For centuries they have been lifelines of mankind, full of stories and history - and in certain countries and areas they also hold great dangers, much human suffering and death. Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto dangerous roads in New Zealand, Scotland and Australia for phoenix.

programme.title: The Moor
programme.desc: Moors and peatlands are oases in the cultivated landscape of Central Europe.

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. It can only happen in Atacama, far away from civilisation’s pollution of the night sky with artificial light.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is an American national park in the southeastern United States, with parts in Tennessee and North Carolina. The park straddles the ridgeline of the Great Smoky Mountains, part of the Blue Ridge Mountains, which are a division of the larger Appalachian Mountain chain. The park contains some of the highest mountains in eastern North America, including Clingmans Dome, Mount Guyot, and Mount Le Conte. The border between the two states runs northeast to southwest through the center of the park. The Appalachian Trail passes through the center of the park on its route from Georgia to Maine. With 12.5 million visitors in 2019, the Great Smoky Mountains National Park is the most visited national park in the United States.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.title: The Seychelles - Africa with South Seas ambience
programme.desc: The 115 islands and islets that make up the Seychelles present a breath-taking variety of plants, rare animals and beaches laced with palms. This is where the leg-endary Coco de Mer palm nuts grow with fruits weigh-ing up to 20 kilos and giant wild land turtles nibble away at mangrove fruits to their hearts content. The archipelago was first settled at the end of the 18th cen-tury. Today, a very colourful potpourri of peoples in this dwarf state proves just how peacefully different cultures can live side by side. Three times a week, the steamer "MV Espoir" completes the trip from the main island of Mahé to Praslin and back. A ship for every-one and practically everything: Used cars, toilet paper, horses, bicycles, furniture - you name it, the Espoir transports goods of all kinds. Coconuts sometimes pose a problem as there are far too many of them. What to do with them? The best place to send them is undoubt-edly Hubert Roumien's Virgin Coconut Oil Laboratory, hidden away in the Mahé jungle. Straw turns into gold at Seaweed Seychelles! There, Benjamin Port Louis collects seaweed and extracts liquid fertiliser from it.

programme.title: mareTV: Capri and the Amalfi Coast - Italy's Ocean Legends
programme.desc: Capri was already in ancient times a place for the rich and beautiful. Today Capri is one of the most famous islands in the world. Millions of tourists visit it. But there are in fact still unknown corners on the island in the Gulf of Naples. Thus, at the very top of Capri, there is a hermit monastery with a view to the Vesuvius.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: The racing cyclists of Burundi have a dangerous job. But it’s a vital one for Burundi’s economy. Bicycles are the main means of transportation in one of the smallest countries in Africa. Bananas, the staple food in Burundi, are transported from the markets to a banana beer brewing factory. We accompany Tharcien, a bike courier, on his exhausting cross country trip on the Burundi Highway.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: It is one of the wildest roads in Asia: the Trans Sulawesi Highway. The adventurous road leads through Indonesia's fourth-largest island and takes people to spectacular destinations. To beautiful beaches, turbulent cities, or unique primeval forests.

programme.title: Hot Roads - The Worlds Most Dangerous Roads
programme.desc: Tanzania is known for its national parks, vast landscapes and wild roads. They make traveling a real adventure. We travel in trucks, buses and off-road vehicles from the Indian Ocean via the Serengeti to Lake Victoria, accompany huge herds of wildebeest, observe lions and rhinos - and show the lives of the people who live on and along the roads.

programme.title: Wild Sardinia
programme.desc: Sardinia has always been the epitome of pure wilderness, an emerald of volcanic origin in the Mediterranean. 1900 metres of coastline and an infinite maze of offshore islands. But Sardinia also has other facets: green valleys, rugged mountains, murmuring brooks, mysterious ruins and a unique fauna. Just off of Sardinia's coast is an untouched underwater paradise - uniquely beautiful, but also dangerous. Pilot whales, dolphins and mobula rays populate the waters at Capo Testa in the north of the island. In the west, the lagoons of Cabras represent a wild landscape of lakes in which thousands of flamingos live and hunt the red brine shrimps. In addition to the flamingos, grey and purple herons and little egrets breed here. Thousands of bats have found refuge in the craggy mountain world of the Supramonte and Gennargentu, with their countless grottoes and caves. In the sea we can observe the mass mating of sea slugs, and thanks to our camera robots and submersible boats we were able to observe beard worms with luminous red gills, as well as bright yellow tree corals in the area surrounding the hypothermal lava holes.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: The contours of the Mediterranean have changed during the course of its history. Near Gibraltar, Africa was once connected to the European continent. When the land bridge at Gibraltar collapsed, the Mediterranean basin filled up again. The Suez Canal is today connected to the Red Sea. This route enables animals to reach the Mediterranean, where they cause problems.

programme.title: Secrets of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: Rugged rocks, blue sea and idyllic, sandy beaches - this is the Mediterranean as we know it. But this impression is deceptive: the Mediterranean is under constant change. The continents are moving towards one another. Animals, that have to survive under such extreme conditions, must find a way to escape the dangers. Between deserts and volcanoes, the challenges for the animals are enormous.

programme.title: mareTV: Scotland's Mild West - On The Inner Hebrides
programme.desc: The Inner Hebrides surprise with green hills, fine sandy beaches and a mild climate, at least as far as Scottish conditions allow. This is ensured by the currents of the Gulf Stream, as well as the Scottish archipelago being protected by its sister islands, which belong to the Outer Hebrides. More than half of the almost 80 islands are uninhabited. Loneliness has made the people rather inventive. On Tiree Island, mathematics, history and physics from the mainland arrive in the classroom per mouseclick. Dr Mauvis Gore and Prof. Rupert Ormond cast off from the island of Mull, after setting a course to encounter a basking shark. The cetohinus maximus is the world's second largest fish and the two scientists are absolutely convinced that the waters surrounding the Mull constitute the mating grounds for the basking sharks. A logistical challenge takes place on the Isle of Easdale each September. Then, around 400 people populate the tiny slate island. Donals "Mellon" Melville organises the World Skimming Championships, a World Cup in jumping stones. This is all about the distance they are thrown and they must only hop above the water twice.

programme.title: Countries People Adventures - Iceland Extreme
programme.desc: In southeastern Iceland, Europe's largest glacier, the gigantic Vatnajökull, covers an area of around 9,000 square kilometers. Beneath it lie the world's most active and dangerous volcanoes. This extreme landscape is as dangerous as it is fascinating: glistening white glacier tongues, lagoons covered with icebergs, bizarre green lava mountains, snow-covered volcanic cones, solidified lava flows and imposing waterfalls overwhelm everyone who gets to see them. In 2008, Icelanders declared the glacier and adjacent areas a national park, the largest in Europe. In this documentary, the team meets people who live, work or do research here: a life with the dangers of fire and ice in the overwhelming landscape of Vatnajökull National Park.

Après Les Grands Mythes, découvrons la mythologie du Grand Nord, qui a abondamment nourri l'histoire de l'art et la pop culture.

programme.title: Cuisines des terroirs
programme.desc: Cuisine des terroirs propose une approche sensuelle de l'art culinaire en allant "sur le terrain" et en rencontrant ceux qui le créent à divers titres: paysans, vignerons, restaurateurs, cuisiniers. La caméra est présente au moment de la récolte, des vendanges, des achats au marché, de la préparation des repas et des fêtes! L'Europe est en marche. Elle n'est pas seulement politique, mais aussi culinaire.

programme.title: Taïwan et ses îles
programme.desc: Malgré sa petite taille, Taïwan abrite plusieurs zones climatiques et une immense biodiversité : voyage à la découverte des îles de l'archipel.

programme.title: La Corée du Sud, un joyau de la nature
programme.desc: Voyage en deux étapes à travers la Corée du Sud, péninsule montagneuse aux paysages sauvages à couper le souffle.

programme.title: La Corée du Sud, un joyau de la nature
L'arme à gauche
programme.desc: Aux Caraïbes, Cournot, navigateur français à quai, est contacté par un certain Hendrix, qui veut une estimation de son yacht. Le lendemain, Hendrix et le bateau ont disparu. Suspecté de vol, Cournot est arrêté, puis innocenté par la vraie propriétaire, qui lui demande de l'aider à retrouver son yacht...

programme.title: Versailles
programme.desc: Dans les années 1660, le jeune Louis XIV prend l'habitude d'investir les jardins de Versailles pour y donner des fêtes somptueuses. Au fil de son ascension, le roi métamorphose le modeste château bâti par son père en palais éblouissant, devenu résidence permanente de la cour à partir de 1682. Chantier ininterrompu au cours de son règne, Versailles n'a ensuite cessé d'être remodelé par ses occupants successifs.

programme.title: Les lionnes de Namibie : Reines de la côte des Squelettes
programme.desc: Située au bord de l'océan Atlantique, au nord-ouest de la Namibie, la côte des Squelettes est une région aussi spectaculaire qu'inhospitalière.

programme.title: Patrimoine mondial de l'Unesco : Trésors culturels - Saison 3
programme.desc: Quatre visites guidées à travers l'Europe, à la découverte de villes classées au patrimoine mondial de l'Unesco.

programme.title: Concert au château de Prague 2026 : Bernstein et Dvorak
Karambolage
programme.desc: Emission franco-allemande de format court dédiée aux cultures françaises et allemandes ainsi qu'aux cultures des minorités présentes dans chacun des deux pays. Sur un ton ludique et humoristique, Karambolage scrute ce qui rapproche et éloigne ces deux cultures.

programme.title: Les couples mythiques du cinéma - Saison 1
programme.desc: Portraits de couples formés par des stars de cinéma, dont les vies personnelles et professionnelles ont été intimement liées et qui se sont nourris l'un l'autre.

programme.title: Marlon Brando : Polynésie, la paix retrouvée
programme.desc: Venu à Tahiti au début des années 1960 pour le tournage des "Révoltés du Bounty", de Lewis Milestone, Marlon Brando découvre Tetiaroa, un atoll de Polynésie française composé de douze îlots pour la plupart inhabités. Harcelée par les médias, la star du cinéma, alors au faîte de sa célébrité, voit dans ce petit paradis l'opportunité de se ressourcer loin de la frénésie de Hollywood.

programme.title: Balentes
programme.desc: Sardaigne, 1940. Alors que l'Italie s'apprête à entrer en guerre au côté de l'Allemagne nazie, Ventura, 11 ans, et Michele, 14 ans, décident de voler les chevaux des paysans qui viennent d'être réquisitionnés par l'armée. Les deux amis se lancent dans un périple pour relâcher les animaux dans les montagnes...

programme.title: Séville, le quartier des nouveaux artisans
programme.desc: En plein cœur de Séville, rencontre avec les artisans installés à Rompemoldes, une cour d'habitation transformée en espace de création qui mêle avant-garde et tradition.

programme.title: Nomade des mers, les escales de l'innovation - Saison 1
programme.desc: Corentin de Chatelperron, ingénieur et navigateur français, voyage à travers le monde sur le catamaran "Nomade des mers" pour découvrir les perspectives de la low-tech.

programme.title: Concorde
programme.desc: Pendant trente ans, le Concorde a filé à la vitesse d'une balle de fusil au-dessus de l'Atlantique. Unique succès du transport civil supersonique de l'histoire, cet avion représentait un véritable miracle technique. Près de vingt ans après l'arrêt de l'exploitation commerciale du Concorde, en 2003, plusieurs projets d'avions de ligne supersoniques sont aujourd'hui en cours de développement.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Ann am Fraochy Bay chan eil leisg sam bith a bhi air Eannruig am posta a bhi air a chois le na litirichean. Agus nuair a tha lorg ga fhaighinn air litir a chailleadh o chionn iomadach bliadhna, tha e dearbhte san ach teid an còir maille oirre. Saoil ge tha dè an seòrsa fàilte a bhios a' feitheamh air? Henry McSparrow, the local Fraochy Bay postie, finds a long-lost letter and sets out on a quest to deliver it to the addressee. It may have been a missive of love, but while it had been missing, has that love waned?

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air a chlàradh aig àm Celtic Connections 2023 agus a’ taisbeanadh cuid den luchd-ciùil a thadhail air an fhèis. Anns a’ phrògram seo, Dàimh agus an triùir sheinneadairean Gàidhlig, Sian, a’ dèanamh ceangal ciùil, agus co-obrachadh ciùil eadar an t-seinneadair Albannach James Yorkston agus Nina Persson bho ‘The Cardigans’. Cuideachd anns a’ phrògram, Amythyst Kiah agus an còmhlan Cuimreach, NoGood Boyo. Trad and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed at Platform in the iconic Argyle Street Arches in Glasgow, Seirm was recorded from Celtic Connections 2023, with performances from some of the best artists at the festival. This programme sees Highland supergroup, Dàimh, join forces with Gaelic vocal trio, Sian, and Scottish singer-songwriter James Yorkston collaborates with Nina Persson of ‘The Cardigans’. Also featured are Amythyst Kiah and Welsh ‘trash-trad’ group, NoGood Boyo. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Kidnapped
programme.desc: Powerful drama based on the true story of the Catholic Church's kidnap of a young Jewish boy. Italy, 1858. Following Pope Pius IX’s orders, soldiers burst into the Mortara family’s Bologna home to forcibly remove their six-year-old son, Edgardo. They have heard from the Jewish family’s maid that she had secretly baptised him as a sickly infant for fear that he would die a Jew and his soul would remain in limbo. Under the Church’s doctrine, the boy is no longer permitted to live with his non-Catholic family and is taken to be raised by the Church itself. The distraught Mortara family try desperately to get Edgardo back, and the scandal soon makes its way across the country and Europe at large. As they embark on an international campaign to have their son returned, they find themselves at the epicentre of a wider historical battle between the forces of Catholic authoritarianism and the political awakening taking place across Italy and throughout Europe. In Italian with English subtitles

programme.title: This is BBC Two
programme.desc: Highlights of programmes on BBC Two.

programme.title: Countryfile
programme.desc: Joe Crowley, Datshiane Navanayagam and Adam Henson head to Westacre Estate in Norfolk to discover how a historic rural estate is adapting to survive in the modern world. At a financially critical time of year, Datshiane looks at one of the estate's most valuable yet vulnerable crops, blueberries, and meets the estate owner to find out how traditional estates are diversifying and evolving to secure their future. Joe joins the conservation team as they work to restore an important area of wet woodland, boosting biodiversity and creating habitats for wildlife. He also visits a tenant brewery and lends a hand to craft a local ale. Meanwhile, Adam meets the estate's farm manager, who is looking at ways to help run the land in a more cost-effective way through collaboration between livestock and arable farming.

programme.title: Breakfast
programme.desc: The latest news, sport, business and weather from the BBC's Breakfast team.

programme.title: Weatherman Walking
programme.desc: Derek explores what lies beneath his feet when he revisits the Great Orme, the Offa’s Dyke Path and the last surviving cast iron footbridge in Merthyr Tydfil.

programme.title: Landward
programme.desc: The Landward team return for the autumn. Dougie is in the Cairngorms to find out how wildlife and precious habitats have been impacted by the summer’s devastating wildfire. Anne reports from the ongoing scene of the fire to see the collective effort to put it out. Shahbaz is in Tayside meeting the scientists using technology to select the crops of the future, and Cammy learns the ropes as he takes part in a clifftop rescue with the coastguard.

programme.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
programme.desc: Matt Tebbutt delivers a tasting menu from favourite Saturday Kitchen chefs. Shivi Ramoutar prepares her green seasoning chicken with coconut rice, peas and a splash of hot pepper sauce. Yotam Ottolenghi dishes up fillets of halibut in a spicy tomato sauce with a tahini dressing and a side of mint and feta-baked rice. Philip Khoury whips up his two-ingredient chocolate mousse served with an abundance of toppings, including chocolate curls, candied pistachios and pistachio praline. Gemma Ogston creates a rainbow curry and spiced apple chutney, and Helen McGinn celebrates an iconic cocktail, the negroni, with a few twists on the classic recipe. Finally, either Harry Judd or his mum Emma face their food heaven. Meanwhile, Rick Stein goes fishing for langoustines in the Scottish Highlands, and the Hairy Bikers explore the melting pot of flavours in Marseilles.

programme.title: Lorraine Pascale: How to Be a Better Cook
programme.desc: With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family. Neil Forster is an impatient cook who reaches for the takeaway menu rather than making food from scratch. Lorraine shows him recipes including asparagus and cream cheese puff pastry tarts, a quick way to do roast chicken and an irresistible summer fruits pudding with a neat shortcut.

programme.title: Nigel and Adam's Farm Kitchen
programme.desc: Nigel Slater and Adam Henson join forces to sow, grow, rear and cook Britain's favourite foods, from a working farm in the Cotswolds. Revealing the top 50 fresh foods on the UK's supermarket shopping lists, Nigel and Adam show how we can get the most flavour, value and variety from them all. The duo look at how our busy lifestyles have meant Britain has lost touch with where our food comes from and the best ways to cook it. With the rise of convenience foods meaning a decline in traditional cooking, can Nigel bring the art of cooking back to Britain? Nigel cooks up our favourite ready meal, lasagne, and tries to match the price of the off-the-shelf version of this popular dish. Adam, meanwhile, sets his own challenge to grow durum wheat, used to make pasta, on the Cotswolds farm. This episode also explores the UK's favourite red meat - beef - and the journey it takes from farm to fork, before Nigel inspires us to get around the table again by cooking a supersized Sunday roast for his guests on the farm.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: A real-life drama about a family of chimps trapped in a lost world. They live in a deep and ancient forested gorge that runs though the African savannah. For 15 years, it has been cut off from the rest of the jungle, leaving the chimps imprisoned. The family face a daily life-or-death dilemma: whether to leave the safety of the gorge and venture into the predator-ridden savannah to find food, or face hunger. There's now only 20 of them left, and as Brutus the alpha male loses his grip, can the family hold it together, or is time running out for the Kyambura chimps?

programme.title: The Big Deal with Steph McGovern
programme.desc: It’s the grand finale, and for the three pairs of aspiring art dealers who have made it through, the ultimate prize of £50,000 of British art is almost within touching distance. Rejoining Steph and series mentor Cordelia de Freitas is guest expert Matt Carey-Williams. The remaining pairs are tested on everything they’ve learnt so far as they’re thrown into the biggest event in the UK art calendar – Frieze Week. For seven days, London becomes the centre of the art universe. After competing to sell art against established art dealers and gallerists for the first time at one of the week's most popular art fairs, one pair is eliminated, and the final two pairs must pitch a six-figure sculpture to a group of industry insiders at the prestigious Frieze sculpture park.

programme.title: Cycling: World Road Championships
programme.desc: Jill Douglas presents live coverage of the UCI Road World Championships women’s time trial – being held for the second time in Montreal, Canada. Switzerland’s Marlon Reusser is looking to retain the title she won in Rwanda last year, but Great Britain’s promising youngster and multiple junior title winner Zoe Backstedt is aiming for her first senior World Championship podium. Commentary comes from Simon Brotherton, Chris Boardman and Hayley Simmonds.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Paul Martin and the team are in the picturesque village of Saltaire, West Yorkshire. It is a world heritage site, so with a historic pedigree like that, expectations are running high with experts David Barby and Michael Baggott. David finds six tasty sandwich markers, but Michael digs out a real treasure - a 400-year-old Laurel gold coin circa 1603 to 1625. Paul also visits Temple Newsam, a 17th-century house being restored to its former glory by a dedicated and skilled team.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: We've taken three soap stars from the road trip archives to see who will clean up at auction. Emmerdale actress Hayley Tamaddon is up against Corrie's Will Mellor and former Queen Vic landlord and all-round geezer Danny Dyer from EastEnders. Ably assisting our soap opera icons are antiques experts and superfans Raj Bisram, Paul Laidlaw and Natasha Raskin Sharp, guiding our stars to all manner of antique items. Will gets to grips with a rather unusual truncheon, Danny has his eye on an intriguing optical instrument, and Hayley takes a punt on some carousel horses. Bring on the drama!

programme.title: Golf: PGA Championship
programme.desc: Action from the final day at Wentworth as a world class field contest the flagship event on the DP World Tour. The winner at the iconic Surrey venue adds their name to an illustrious list of previous champions, including Rory McIlroy, Luke Donald, Seve Ballesteros and Nick Faldo. Two-time winner Alex Noren defends the title he won in 2025 after a dramatic play-off victory.

programme.title: Secrets of the Bayeux Tapestry: Inside the Museum
programme.desc: The Bayeux Tapestry is one of the treasures of the medieval world. Across 70 metres of exquisitely embroidered scenes, it tells the story of one of the most seismic events in British history – the Norman Invasion of 1066. For the last 950 years, this crucial part of Britain's national story has remained on the other side of the English Channel, in Bayeux, Normandy, but now it’s coming back to the UK. A stellar cast of historians and experts follow the painstaking efforts to bring this priceless work of art back to the UK, where experts believe it was made, for a once-in-a-millennium exhibition at the British Museum.

programme.title: Pilgrimage
programme.desc: Seven celebrities of differing faiths and beliefs experience an emotional journey on a pilgrimage in north Wales, a route linked by churches dedicated to early Celtic Christian saints. Immersing themselves on this spiritual journey are wildlife presenter Michaela Strachan, who places her faith in the natural world; Spencer Matthews, a former Made in Chelsea reality star who was christened in the Church of England but is still searching for answers to life’s big questions; Sonali Shah, a journalist and TV presenter who grew up in a Jain family; comedian Eshaan Akbar, a lapsed Muslim; Amanda Lovett, a practising Catholic who was catapulted into the public eye in the first series of Traitors; actor Tom Rosenthal of Friday Night Dinner fame, who is areligious; and TV personality and former model Christine McGuinness, who is spiritual but doesn’t practise one particular faith. Travelling on foot and by bus, the seven pilgrims begin their adventure at Flint Castle on the bank of the Dee Estuary and follow the coastal path to Greenfield Valley, the official start of the 220km Pilgrim’s Way.

programme.title: Wilderness with Simon Reeve
programme.desc: Simon Reeve ventures deep into one of the most remote and biologically rich regions on Earth, the rainforests of Papua New Guinea, in search of one of the rarest creatures on the planet - the tenkile tree kangaroo. Covering just a tiny fraction of the planet’s land surface, tropical rainforests hold more than half of the world’s plant and animal species – and few places rival New Guinea for sheer diversity. The island is home to vast wilderness areas that remain little known to science, a lost world with countless species still undiscovered.

programme.title: Slumdog Millionaire
programme.desc: An orphan from the slums of Mumbai makes it all the way to the final question of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire. The police think he must be cheating, but Jamal's whole life has led to this moment.

programme.title: Saving Lives at Sea
programme.desc: When a kayaker calls a friend to say she’s in trouble out at sea, the line suddenly goes dead; the Happisburgh lifeboat crew finally find her over a mile off shore, face down and unresponsive. In St Helier, the capital of Jersey, a family have had to abandon their grounded yacht, leaving four young children in a life raft. On the north Yorkshire coast, the Withernsea crew respond to a 999 call from a young man cut off on some notoriously unstable cliffs. And in Littlehampton, West Sussex, a mayday call comes in from a dive boat that has lost engine power - leaving two of its divers drifting away.

programme.title: Crossing
programme.desc: Retired Georgian teacher Lia is on a mission to find her long-lost niece, a trans woman called Tekla, who is rumoured to have moved to Istanbul and whom Lia promised her dying sister she would bring home. Lia finds an unlikely companion in Achi, the hapless young son of one of her former pupils, who insists he has important information about Lia's niece's whereabouts and who is itching to leave home. Together, Lia and Achi set out on their journey, crossing the border into Turkey and venturing into the big city in search of missing Tekla. In Georgian, Turkish and English.

programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Nancy, who adamantly denies her online love relationship with "Shaun" is a scam. Nancy and her son Darcy speak face-to-face for the first time in over a year. Plus updates from past catfished guests!

programme.desc: Are you a 'social media lurker?' How often do you scroll through social media platforms to stare at other people's photos and videos and decide that person is surely living their best life, and you are not. A deep dive into posting: real vs fake.

programme.desc: This 2004 YouTube viral video sent shock waves, racked up millions of views, and stirred online outrage. Texas Judge William Adams is lashing his then 16-year-old daughter with a belt, despite her pleas to stop. Do you think Adam's actions are justified?

programme.title: Eine Sennerin zum Verlieben
programme.desc: Krawatte trifft auf Dirndl, Vegetarier auf Schweinshaxe: Umrahmt von der malerischen Alpenlandschaft des Karwendelgebirges, zettelt Dietmar Klein einen humorvollen Beziehungskrieg an, der seinen vergnüglichen Reiz aus dem Aufeinanderprallen charakterlicher Gegensätze bezieht. Wenn sich das Hauptdarsteller-Duo Michaela May und Günther Maria Halmer bissige Wortgefechte liefert, vor wilden Stieren flüchtet und mit dem eigenen Unvermögen hadert, beweist die Komödie Sinn für Situationskomik. Auf ihrer Alm fühlt sich die bodenständige Milchbäuerin Ariane Ostler am wohlsten. Hier, oberhalb des bayerischen Städtchens Reichertsbrunn, lebt sie zurückgezogen, aber zufrieden, zwischen ihren Kühen. ...

programme.title: Wasser für die wilde Isar
programme.desc: Die Obere Isar im Werdenfelser Land gilt als der letzte große Wildfluss Deutschlands. Aber der größte Teil des Wassers wird zur Energiegewinnung für das Walchenseekraftwerk abgeleitet. Doch es gibt noch eine letzte Chance, diesen einmaligen Wildfluss zu retten. Mehr als 200 bedrohte Tier- und Pflanzenarten leben im und am breiten wilden Kiesbett der Oberen Isar im Werdenfelser Land. Doch die Landschaft des letzten großen deutschen Wildflusses ist bedroht. Sie wird von grünem Dickicht überwuchert, weil der größte Teil des Wassers zur Energiegewinnung für das Walchenseekraftwerk abgeleitet wird. Dem Fluss bleibt nur die sogenannte Restwassermenge. Zu wenig, um den Kies, der den Wildfluss ...

programme.title: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel
programme.desc: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel - Die Sendung nimmt sich Zeit für besondere Geschichten aus den Regionen Bayerns und lädt dazu ein, genauer hinzuschauen und Neues zu entdecken. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Menschen, die mit Engagement, Kreativität und Leidenschaft ihre Heimat prägen und bewahren. Reportagen und Porträts vermitteln Einblicke in Geschichte und Gegenwart, in Traditionen, Handwerk, Kultur und Natur. Dabei erzählt die Sendung von einem lebendigen und verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Heimat und zeigt, wie vielfältig das Leben zwischen Spessart und Karwendel ist. Authentische Begegnungen und eindrucksvolle Landschaften machen jede Ausgabe zu einer abwechslungsreichen Entdeckungsreise durch Bayern.

programme.title: Quarks
programme.desc: Quarks - Thema: Regional und saisonal im Trend - was ist dran? Beiträge: Blaubeer-Boom (1) Blaubeer-Boom (2) Vitamin-C Check bei Obst und Gemüse Wochenmarkt (1) TOP3 Äpfel Tomaten-Klimabilanz Wochenmarkt (2) Warum ist REGIONAL gerade im Trend? Endlich Erntezeit! Beste Zeit für regionale und saisonale Lebensmittel! Diese sind im Trend. Denn sie sollen nicht nur die lokale Wirtschaft stärken, sondern auch der Umwelt guttun und sogar besser für unsere Gesundheit sein. Aber stimmt das alles? Viele wollen sich bewusster ernähren und sind bereit, dafür auch mehr Geld auszugeben. Marketing-Experten nutzen das und kleben immer öfter das Label "Regional" auf die Tomate oder Heidelbeere. Dabei ist das kein ...

programme.title: Kunst + Krempel
programme.desc: Kunst & Krempel - Werke: Eine Blumenschale aus Silber Ein Gemälde Ein Porzellangefäß Eine historische Radierung Familienschätze, Dachbodenfunde, Flohmarktschnäppchen: Was die Gäste den Expertinnen und Experten bei "Kunst + Krempel" auf den Tisch legen, sorgt immer wieder für große Überraschungen. Und lässt in den Beratungen Kunstgeschichte lebendig werden. Die Blumenschale aus Silber ist eine Jardini¿re im Jugendstil, die von einem bedeutenden Hoflieferanten stammt, so die Expertinnen. Außerdem gibt es Beratungen zu einem Gemälde, einem außergewöhnlichen Porzellangefäß und einer historischen Radierung.

programme.title: Logistik-Wahnsinn Oktoberfest
programme.desc: Jede U-Bahn bringt pro Fahrt 1.000 Leute aufs Festgelände. Bis zu 18.000 Essen müssen im Löwenbräuzelt raus. Und die Sicherheit der Gäste ist oberstes Gebot. "Logistik-Wahnsinn Oktoberfest": die Reportage hinter den Kulissen von Zelt-Großküche, Sicherheit und U-Bahn. Das Oktoberfest ist eine Logistik-Maschine: Zelt-Großküche, Sicherheit und U-Bahn müssen funktionieren, um die Massen zu bewältigen. Die Reportage "Logistik-Wahnsinn Oktoberfest" blickt hinter die Kulissen des größten Festbetriebes der Welt. Chefkoch Martin Wacker arbeitet jeden Tag 17 Stunden und ist verantwortlich für die Logistik der Löwenbräu-Großküche. Produktion, Bestellungen, Qualitätskontrolle - er muss fast überall ...

programme.title: Space Night
programme.desc: Space Night - Heute: How to become an Astronaut? Die Sendung nimmt die Zuschauerinnen und Zuschauer mit auf eine faszinierende Reise durch das Universum. Eindrucksvolle Aufnahmen und wissenschaftlich fundierte Animationen machen ferne Galaxien, Sterne und kosmische Phänomene erlebbar. Grundlage sind die Erkenntnisse modernster Observatorien und Teleskope, die mit hochentwickelter Technik immer tiefere Einblicke in das Weltall ermöglichen. Die Sendung verbindet anschaulich die jahrtausendealte Faszination für die Astronomie mit den neuesten Ergebnissen der Weltraumforschung und lädt dazu ein, die unendlichen Weiten des Kosmos zu entdecken.

programme.title: Gesundheit!
programme.desc: Gesundheit! - Heute: Die Bewegungs-Docs Themen: Bluthochdruck Bandscheibenvorwölbung Die Bewegungs-Docs: Medizin, die etwas bewegt - ohne Risiken und Nebenwirkungen. Die "Docs" sind: Melanie Hümmelgen, Christian Sturm und Helge Riepenhof. Sie alle sind erfahrene Mediziner, wollen mit gezielten Bewegungsstrategien Symptome deutlich verbessern und Krankheiten sogar heilen. Bluthochdruck Zwei Medikamente täglich - und trotzdem zu hoher Blutdruck: Anja Nicke fühlt sich erschöpft, kurzatmig und nach der Arbeit völlig ausgelaugt. Treppensteigen oder selbst die Hunderunde werden zur Belastung. Melanie Hümmelgen zeigt, wie gefährlich unbehandelter Bluthochdruck für Herz und Gefäße werden kann - erste Schäden ...

programme.title: Dahoam is Dahoam
programme.desc: Ein Ritual für die Liebe - Die Sendung erzählt Geschichten aus dem fiktiven oberbayerischen Dorf Lansing, wo Tradition, Gemeinschaft und dörflicher Alltag eng miteinander verwoben sind. Im Zentrum stehen die Familien und Bewohner, deren humorvolle, herzliche und manchmal konfliktreiche Erlebnisse den Charme der Serie ausmachen. Schauplätze wie der Brunnerwirt, der Dorfplatz oder die Werkstatt bilden den vertrauten Rahmen, in dem Beziehungen wachsen, alte Werte gepflegt und neue Herausforderungen gemeistert werden. Nordic Walking wurde ursprünglich als Sommertraining für Skilangläufer entwickelt. Es ist das perfekte Ganzkörpertraining für jedermann, da 90% aller Muskeln im Einsatz sind. programme.title: Des Kaisers neue Kleider
programme.desc: Mit List und Tücke gelingt es Jakob (Matthias Brandt) sich bei Kaiser Friedhelm (Sergej Moya) als bester Weber des Landes auszugeben und engagiert zu werden. Obwohl das Volk völlig verarmt ist und die Bürger Not leiden, gibt der Kaiser Unmengen für seine Garderobe aus. Jakob verspricht für das große Geburtstagsfest des Kaisers, ihm die großartigsten Kleider zu schneidern. Über das Ergebnis ist nicht nur das Volk völlig verwundert ... Voller Witz und Kühnheit wandert Jakob durchs Land. Als er eines Tages in die Stadt gelangt, macht er die Bekanntschaft der hübschen Maja und ihrer kleinen Schwester Greta. Werner Otto glaubt, daraus Vorteil ziehen zu können, und wettet, dass Bimbo ihn innerhalb von drei Tagen ins Kino begleiten wird. Doch seine unbeholfenen Versuche, sich Bimbo anzunähern, scheitern - und er verliert die Wette. Die Sommerferien fangen an, zu dumm, dass Bimbo am letzten Schultag noch Stress mit einem Klassenkameraden hat. Werner Otto hat gehört, dass Peter und Bimbo Krach haben. Jetzt hofft er auf seine große Chance. Optimistisch schließt er sogar schon eine Wette ab: In drei Tagen, so behauptet er, wird Bimbo ihn ins Kino begleiten. Jahrgang durften sich interessierte Spitzentalente, die eine Karriere als Profis anstreben, in den Fächern Fagott, Orgel, Schlagzeug und Streichquartett miteinander messen. programme.title: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel
programme.desc: Zwischen Spessart und Karwendel - Die Sendung nimmt sich Zeit für besondere Geschichten aus den Regionen Bayerns und lädt dazu ein, genauer hinzuschauen und Neues zu entdecken. Abgesehen von ein paar markanten Felsen, die wie Riffe aus dem Meer einer idyllischen Landschaft emporragen: Roß- und Buchstein, der Leonhardstein, die Daffensteine und der Blankenstein. programme.desc: Er gilt als einer der größten und schönsten Umzüge der Welt und ist zugleich ein echt bayerisches Ereignis mit königlicher Geschichte: In Erinnerung an den legendären Festzug zur Silberhochzeit von König Ludwig I. und Therese von Bayern im Jahr 1835 zieht in München alle Jahre am ersten Wiesn-Sonntag der Oktoberfest Trachten- und Schützenzug durch die Innenstadt. programme.desc: Oft werden Joppen, Spenzer und Mieder über viele Generationen weitergegeben. Aber es braucht besonderes Handwerk, das Schuhe, Hüte, Röcke oder Hosenträger gefertigt und angepasst werden können - Handwerk, das heute selten geworden ist. Um sechs Uhr in der Früh schießen die Karlsteiner Böllerschützen den Weckruf zu ihrem Jubiläum über den Reichenhaller Talkessel. Zur selben Zeit müssen die Dirndln des Trachtenvereins Kranzlstoaner anfangen, sich für den Festtag zu frisieren und anzukleiden. Denn die traditionelle Gretlfrisur, das "Gredei", und das Ankleiden der Tracht brauchen viel Zeit und gegenseitige Hilfe. programme.title: Morgue
programme.desc: Diego, vigile de nuit dans un hôpital, entend des bruits étranges lors de sa première ronde. Piégé dans la morgue, il comprend vite que le lieu n’est pas vide… et que quelque chose rôde dans l’ombre.

programme.title: La disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee a disparu á l'Institut national d'investigation scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han prétend qu'elle est vivante.

programme.title: After Life
programme.desc: Après un accident de voiture, Anna se réveille sur le canapé du salon funéraire d'Eliot Deacon, préparant son corps pour les funérailles. L'homme explique qu'il a le don de communiquer avec les morts.

programme.title: Bleeding Steel
programme.desc: Une invention biochimique permet de sauver la fille de Lin Dong. Mais elle est convoitée par un mystérieux groupe criminel. Lin Dong va tout faire pour la protéger des criminels qui la traque.

programme.title: 303 Squadron FR
programme.desc: Le 303 Squadron, dans lequel servaient principalement des aviateurs polonais, a défendu avec héroïsme l'Angleterre contre les nazis. Cet escadron de chasse a touché trois fois plus d'avions de la Luftwaffe que tous les autres escadrons alliés.

programme.title: Fast and Fierce: Death Race
programme.desc: Jack Tyson est sur le point de remporter le prix en espèces d'une course automobile illégale du Mexique à la Californie lorsqu'une femme désespérée, fuyant son petit ami gangster qui dirige le tournoi, saute dans sa voiture pour demander de l'aide.

programme.title: Absolute Race
programme.desc: Max mène une vie rangée, avec Alice et leur fils Théo jusqu’à ce qu’Alice se retrouve à l’hôpital, mourante, dans l’attente d’un nouveau cœur qui ne vient pas. Max renoue avec son passé de coureur automobile de rue afin de sauver sa femme.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: De forts vents menacent de se transformer en un super cyclone qui se dirige tout droit sur la côte est des États-Unis. Il promet de tout dévaster sur son passage. Un météorologue et un ingénieur pétrolier unissent leurs forces.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Un membre incorruptible qui vient d'être promu à la police des polices de Los Angeles découvre qu'un policier, en apparence intègre, est mêlé à de nombreux trafics...

programme.title: Elektra
programme.desc: Elektra, célèbre tueuse à gages, accepte un contrat qu’elle refusera plus tard de remplir en protégeant sa cible et la fille de celui-ci de la terrible et maléfique organisation criminelle appelée « La Main ».

programme.title: Absolute deception FR
programme.desc: John Nelson, agent du FBI, apprend que son meilleur indicateur, Miles, a été enlevé puis assassiné.

programme.title: Bullet
programme.desc: Frank Marasco, surnommé « Bullet », est le flic le plus féroce de Los Angeles. Il s'apprête à partir à la retraite. Lorsque son petit-fils est kidnappé, il décide de se faire justice lui-même : il ne reculera devant rien pour le retrouver.

programme.title: 13 ASESINOS
programme.desc: Un ingenuo joven adopta la identidad de un hombre muerto para unirse a un juego de mafiosos de ruleta rusa. Con Mickey Rourke, Jason Statham y Michael Shannon.

programme.title: Survivor
programme.desc: Incriminada por crímenes que no cometió, una diplomática (Milla Jovovich, El quinto elemento) trata de impedir un ataque terrorista en Nueva York. Con Pierce Brosnan y Dylan McDermott.

programme.title: Perdido en la fama
programme.desc: Un rockero semi retirado y caprichoso (Antonio Banderas) debe espabilarse para rescatar a su esposa, quien ha sido secuestrada mientras se encontraba de vacaciones en Chile.

programme.title: Bent: Plan de venganza
programme.desc: En este mordaz thriller policíaco, un policía desacreditado que busca al asesino de su compañero descubre accidentalmente una conspiración gubernamental vinculada al asesinato de una mujer con un coche bomba.

programme.title: Apocalypto (ESP)
programme.desc: Cuando el reino maya está al borde del colapso, un joven se embarca en un peligroso viaje hacia un mundo dominado por el miedo y la opresión.

programme.title: Atrapen al gringo
programme.desc: Un criminal de carrera, capturado por las autoridades mexicanas, es enviado a una prisión de alta seguridad donde aprende a sobrevivir con la ayuda de un niño

programme.title: Sirenas
programme.desc: Una joven se ve atrapada en una guerra emocional, al lidiar con su primer amor y una madre poco convencional.

programme.title: Las estafadoras
programme.desc: Una mujer y su hija son estafadoras profesionales que utilizan sus armas de seducción para engañar a millonarios, hasta que la joven hija se enamora poniendo en apuros el último golpe: un excéntrico magnate del tabaco.

programme.title: Cartas a Julieta
programme.desc: Mientras está de vacaciones en Verona, Sophie se encuentra con una carta a Julieta y se embarca en una misión para encontrar a su autor.

programme.title: Sirenas
programme.desc: Una joven se ve atrapada en una guerra emocional, al lidiar con su primer amor y una madre poco convencional.

programme.title: Lo que ellas quieren
programme.desc: Nick Marshall (Mel Gibson), un ejecutivo publicitario y soltero promiscuo, obtiene accidentalmente el poder de oír lo que piensan las mujeres. Nick decide usar su nuevo poder para sabotear a su jefa, Darcy (Helen Hunt), y avanzar en su propia carrera.

programme.title: Jean de la Fontaine, le défi
programme.desc: Paris, 1661. Alors que tous les artistes du royaume de France cherchent à entrer dans les bonnes grâces du roi Soleil, Jean de La Fontaine n’hésite pas à dénoncer les abus du pouvoir.

programme.title: D'artagnan
programme.desc: Le roman d'Alexandre Dumas est mis à jour avec une influence orientale. D'Artagnan tente de rejoindre les gardes d'élite du roi, les mousquetaires royaux et de trouver le meurtrier de ses parents.

programme.title: Beyond the Edge
programme.desc: Une bande d’arnaqueurs talentueux dotés de superpouvoirs tente de dévaliser un énorme casino, mais c’est sans compter sur un mystérieux rival qui semble tous les surpasser…

programme.title: L'Heure du crime FR
programme.desc: Sonia est femme de ménage dans un hôtel. Guido est un ancien policier, qui travaille désormais comme gardien. Leurs chemins se croisent lors d'un speed dating. Ils se parlent à peine, mais sont tout de suite attirés l'un par l'autre.

programme.title: Le Smoking
programme.desc: Jimmy Tong, simple chauffeur de taxi devenu chauffeur personnel, enfile un smoking d'une valeur de 2 milliards de dollars appartenant à un espion et devient sans le vouloir un fringant agent secret.

programme.title: Rain Fall
programme.desc: Un assassin traqué par la CIA tente de découvrir la vérité derrière un complot international.

programme.title: Golem le tueur de Londres
programme.desc: Une série de meurtres secouent le quartier malfamé de Limehouse. Selon la rumeur, ces crimes ne peuvent avoir été perpétrés que par le Golem, une créature des légendes hébraïques d’Europe centrale.

programme.title: The Happy Prince
programme.desc: L'histoire inédite des derniers jours de la tragédie d'Oscar Wilde, une personne observant son propre échec avec une distance ironique et qui considère les difficultés qui assaillent sa vie avec détachement et humour.

programme.title: Une idée de génie
programme.desc: Deux amis s'associent et rencontrent le succès.

programme.title: Alerte Tsunamis
programme.desc: Le premier frappe sans prévenir. Puis un autre. Bientôt, les énormes murs d’eau engloutissent côte après côte, ville après ville. Alors que d’innombrables vies sont perdues dans l’assaut, le pire reste à venir.

programme.title: 40 Days and Nights
programme.desc: Suite à un important séisme, une plaque tectonique provoque un véritable soulèvement des océans. Pour faire face à la panique, l'armée américaine décide de construire une arche pour préserver la vie sur Terre.

programme.title: Le Triangle De L'apocalypse
programme.desc: Tom, pilote d’hélicoptère, emmène Marie, RP d’un groupe énergétique, sur une plateforme en mer pour un événement. En vol, il aperçoit le bateau d’un ami pêcheur : tout l’équipage est mort. Ce qui devait être une mission banale vire au cauchemar…

programme.title: Mega Shark versus Crocosaurus
programme.desc: L’énorme requin préhistorique a survécu à la dernière bataille, mais le monde tremble à nouveau quand un rival encore plus dangereux fait son apparition en Afrique.

programme.title: Earthquake Underground
programme.desc: Un tremblement de terre libère un ancien secret enfoui sous terre, menaçant la survie de millions de personnes.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Un building de 50 étages. Une simple négligence. Des milliers de personnes prises aux pièges par l'incendie le plus dévastateur de la décennie. Seul rempart contre les flammes, une escouade de soldats du feu surentrainée et prête à tout pour intervenir.

programme.title: Asteroid: Final Impact
programme.desc: Steve est un scientifique de renom dont l'image a récemment était écorchée. Alors qu'une pluie d'astéroïdes se déverse sur la planète, il découvre qu'une menace bien plus grande nous attend : un astéroïde d'une taille astronomique qui détruirait la terre.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Un building de 50 étages. Une simple négligence. Des milliers de personnes prises aux pièges par l'incendie le plus dévastateur de la décennie. Seul rempart contre les flammes, une escouade de soldats du feu surentrainée et prête à tout pour intervenir.

programme.title: The Captain
programme.desc: Basé sur l'incident qui a eu lieu en mai 2018, lorsque le pare-brise du cockpit d'un vol de Sichuan Airlines s'est brisé en morceaux alors que l'avion volait à 30 000 pieds au-dessus du plateau tibétain.

programme.title: Alana : Déesse de Justice
programme.desc: Séparée de ses parents à la naissance, Alana grandit dans une société corrompue. Sujette à d’étranges colères, elle découvre qu’elle est la réincarnation de Sri Asih, déesse de justice. Ses pouvoirs vont bientôt changer le cours des choses.

programme.title: La sorcière blanche
programme.desc: Au crépuscule de la dynastie des Ming, les Mandchous sont prêts à attaquer l’empire affaibli. La sorcière Jade Rashka sauve alors les victimes en combattant les soldats.

programme.title: Undercover Punch and Gun
programme.desc: Wu, policier infiltré au sein d’un réseau de méthamphétamine, doit s'associer à une bande hétéroclite pour faire tomber un énorme trafic de drogue.

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: Lorsque Fung voit Sing, un moine, mettre en déroute des voyous avec un simple ballon, il a l'ingénieuse idée de créer une équipe de foot.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: 1620, He Ying a pour mission d'apporter une machine pour voyager dans le temps à son empereur. Il est attaqué sont ensevelis sous une avalanche. He Ying et Sao se réveillent quatre siècles plus tard et poursuivre leur affrontement.

programme.title: Ip Man and Four Kings
programme.desc: En 1950 à Hong Kong, le maître de Wing Chun Ye Wen (Tang Wenlong) se fait remarquer et attire l'attention de Zheng Delong (Lin Fengyi). Il se retrouve alors confronté aux "4 Rois", des maîtres redoutables dans un univers de rivalités et de trahisons.

programme.title: Invincible Dragon
programme.desc: Kowloon, agent infiltré au dragon tatoué, aide la police à résoudre des affaires étranges. Mais son tempérament bagarreur l’oppose à un vétéran américain, dont le lien caché avec son passé menace de tout bouleverser.
